evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure was 3.037 Torr before a sustained rise.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.481 Torr while temperature remains near 750 °C and Ar flow near 100 sccm; the pressure trend is not explained by changing setpoints.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; no oxygen measurements are available to verify the growth atmosphere.
The supplied growth-stage check requires an exhaust O2 sensor, which is absent.

args.missing_evidence: Validated exhaust oxygen measurement is required to verify atmosphere; independent pressure verification and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish causes of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
